title: Determinant bounds 1 <= det(I + G) <= exp(trace G) for a symmetric positive semidefinite real matrix G
statement: For every natural number n and every real n x n matrix G (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) assume two things: G is symmetric, G^T = G (Matrix.IsSymm G); and G is positive semidefinite, x . (G x) = sum_a x_a sum_b G_ab x_b >= 0 for every x : Fin n -> R (0 <= dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec G x)). Let I be the n x n identity matrix and I + G the entrywise sum. Then 1 <= det(I + G) and det(I + G) <= exp(trace G).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), Matrix.IsSymm G → (∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, 0 ≤ dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec G x)) → 1 ≤ Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + G) ∧ Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + G) ≤ Real.exp (Matrix.trace G)
